name: Asahi Holdings, Inc.
summary: Asahi Holdings, Inc. engages in the recycling and sale of precious and rare metals in Japan, rest of Asia, and North America. The company operates through three segments: Precious Metals, Environmental Preservation, and Life and Health. It collects and recycles various metals, including gold, silver, palladium, and platinum used in a range of industry fields, such as E-scrap, dentistry, jewelry, plating treatment, precision cleaning, photography, catalysts, and liquid crystal display. The company also refines and processes precious metals, such as gold and silver; and recycles waste oil and sludge, wood waste, fire-proof bricks, glass products, waste acids and reagents, alkalis, and sludge. In addition, it manufactures and sells massage chairs, small massagers, alkaline water ionizers, hearing aids, home-use treatment equipment, and fitness equipment, as well as designs and installs air-conditioning systems, as well as constructs facilities for fire-prevention and sanitation. The company was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.
